narrationTexts: Vendor file explicitly says "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade." Skipping that one. Confirming `lib/db.js` still exposes `query` before I proceed.
All 12 non-vendor files follow this identical 3-call shape. Migrating each with the same `sql`/`params` rewrite the already-migrated services use.
Verifying no `db.query` calls remain outside vendor.
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved 12 files from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used across the codebase.

One `db.query` call remains, in `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. That file is a vendored copy replaced wholesale on every upstream upgrade, with a comment saying not to edit it, so I left it alone.

Next: `db.query` is still exported from `lib/db.js` for that vendor adapter. Drop it only after the vendor package itself moves to `execute`.
